mapper.select: SELECT a.`id` `id`, a.`device_id` `deviceId`, a.`group_control_id` `groupControlId`, b.`device_name` `deviceName` FROM `group_base_details` a LEFT JOIN `security_device` b ON a.`device_id` = b.`device_id` where a.`group_control_id` = #{param.groupControlId} and b.`application_code` = #{param.applicationCode}

select g.`id`,g.`group_control_name` as `name`,count(r.`device_id`) as `num` from `group_base_info` g left join `group_base_details` r on g.`id` = r.`group_control_id` where g.`deleted` = 0 group by g.`id`
